'''Huan''' was the ''[[so'jhin]]'' of [[Turak Aladon]].

== Appearance ==
His left side of the scalp was shaved, the remaining pale golden hair was braided to his shoulder.

== Activities ==
He greeted [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and [[Bayle Domon]], when they arrived with the ''[[Cuendillar]]'' [[Seal]] for Turak.{{ref/book|2|29}} He was also there when [[Padan Fain]] delivers the [[Horn of Valere]] to Turak.{{ref/book|2|34}} Huan followed orders from Turak adamantly, but was vicious when he felt Turak's guests were disrespecting Turak. This trait grew into hatred by Fain, who swore to himself that he would kill Huan slowly. He was later found dead and Turak suspected that Fain killed him.
